topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: I can't believe I found him. Here, of all places, at this bustling yard sale on a random Sunday. There he is, sitting quietly among old books and broken toys, as if he's been waiting for me. I know it's him—no mistaking those patched-up seams and the faded blue bow. My hands tremble as I reach out, afraid he might vanish if I touch him. The world seems to pause, and all I can think about is getting him back home where he belongs. I have to have him. I'm already scanning my pockets for money, hoping I have enough. I can’t lose him again.
